summary: The note is a short encyclopedia-style entry on Instituto Piaget, a private higher education institution in Portugal. It offers both university and polytechnic programs across several fields. The institution is named after the Swiss philosopher and developmental psychologist Jean Piaget.
one_line: Instituto Piaget is a Portuguese private higher education institution offering university and polytechnic programs, named after Jean Piaget.
key_facts: Instituto Piaget is a Portuguese private institution of higher education.
Instituto Piaget provides both university and polytechnic higher education.
Instituto Piaget offers higher education in a number of fields.
Instituto Piaget was named after the Swiss philosopher and developmental psychologist Jean Piaget.
